about_the_game:
Speed Vortex launches you into an electrifying, high-speed journey where every second and every movement can decide your fate. Take control of a fearless young rider soaring through a futuristic world on a hoverboard powered by cutting-edge propulsion technology.

Your mission is clear: push the boundaries of speed, reflex, and precision as you weave through a maze of deadly obstacles in a neon-drenched environment that never stops testing you.

The secret to survival lies in mastering the hoverboard’s 360° rotation system — spin, flip, and dodge with perfect timing to slip past incoming hazards and turn close calls into breathtaking escapes.

Every run in Speed Vortex is a thrilling dance of motion and danger, where sharp reflexes and cool nerves are the only things standing between glory and disaster. Immerse yourself in its sleek visuals, fluid gameplay, and unrelenting pace — and see how long you can defy gravity before it all comes crashing down.

Are you bold enough to conquer the vortex?

🌀 Game Features

  • ⚡ Adrenaline-fueled gameplay that demands quick reflexes and focus

  • 🔄 Unique 360° rotation mechanic for skillful obstacle evasion

  • 💰 Collect coins

  • 🌆 Futuristic, vibrant worlds with ever-changing challenges

    Speed, precision, and courage — that’s what it takes to survive the vortex.
    How far can you go before the crash?
